posts.instagram:
The drums kick in and the whole stand feels it.

Black College Drumline is an adult coloring book that celebrates Black college drumline culture, made for anyone who loves the music and the show of a college band. It's Book 9 in the Multicultural Adult Coloring Books series.

Put on your favorite band cadence, grab your pencils and bring your own colors to a theme rooted in music and performance. Find it on Amazon, or as a printable PDF on Etsy.

🥁 Black College Drumline: Celebrating the Culture of Drumline Bands, from Cocoa Butter Books
